title: Console: live timeline and 5-beat pacing
outcome: ks console --live renders ticks, alerts, controls and holds, with pacing for the CALL-01/zoya section 4 beats
acceptance: Live view shows per-tick records, alerts, suspend and holds from the run dir/operator socket, read-only
Pacing mode stops at beat boundaries (break, identify, contain, recover, audit) with a keypress; timings fit 5 min on the hero seed
Degraded isolation and repro banners always visible
summary: ks.console (model/html/live) built; ks console RUN --html|--live [--once] [--pace]. Static single-file page, deterministic, offline, read-only, build-time verify + degraded/repro banners. 5 beats; hero beats (alert/suspend/dry-run lanes) render live when alerts/controls/plans exist, else marked PENDING from contract-shaped fixture. --pace stops per beat on Enter (300s budget). Run pacing (--pause-at/--step) still waits on RunOptions SERVED. ADR-07 amendment: --pace flag. tests/console 7 pass; test_cli placeholder list updated (console removed).
